name: Formal Constraint Relaxation Witness
description: Instead of explicitly describing the conditions p1+p2 > T and sum(p) > T, I defined the scheduling problem constraints formally (start times, non-overlapping intervals, precedence constraint). Then I defined the certificates as relaxations of these constraints: "isolation witness" (drop all other jobs) and "relaxation witness" (drop the precedence constraint). This forces the model to mathematically derive the lower bounds for each relaxation to figure out what to compute.
